value.title: Go! Princess PreCure the Movie: Go! Go!! Splendid Triple Feature!!!
value.synopsis: The Pumpkin Kingdom's Treasure Good day! I am Haruno Haruka! We went to a fairyland country called Pumpkin Kingdom after the cafe we were in teleported us there! However, the princess of the country was found to be missing!! Pretty Cure and Refi's Wonder Night! We are then flown to a country known as the Pumpkingdom, which is sentenced with an eternal nighttime by darkness by Night Pumpkin! Cure Flora and the Mischievous Mirror An excited Cure Flora is holding nice hair ornaments in her hands. As she carefully opens the hair ornaments, a curtain immediately opens up, resulting in Cure Flora coughing away the dust. When the dust settles down, a mirror is seen before her but the Cure Flora in the mirror is making a strange face....
